## Plugin reference

- Description: Paste a URL into an empty text block to turn it into a bookmark or embed.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `page/editor.BlockTextPluginProps`
    - `page/editor.registerBlockTextExtension`
    - `primitives/css/row.Row`

- E2e:
